title: ACDP Lifecycle Event Receipt (0.5.0)
description: A registry-signed attestation that a lifecycle event was appended at index 'index' of a context's lifecycle_events, with registry acceptance time 'accepted_at' (RFC-ACDP-0017 §10, amending RFC-ACDP-0013). Served in registry_state.event_receipts, parallel to lifecycle_events. The preimage is the JCS canonicalization of this object minus 'signature'; the registry signs the ASCII bytes of 'sha256:<hex(SHA-256(preimage))>' with its receipt key, exactly as RFC-ACDP-0010 §5. Additive minor, so this schema lives in the v0.1.0 namespace (VERSIONING.md).

receipt_type.description: Domain separator: distinguishes an event receipt preimage from every other object signed under the receipt key (RFC-ACDP-0017 §10.1).

registry_did.description: The minting registry's DID: did:web:<authority> where <authority> equals the context's origin_registry (RFC-ACDP-0017 §10.3 step 2).

event_id.description: The event_id of the receipted event.

event_hash.description: sha256:<hex(SHA-256(JCS(event)))> over the full stored event object INCLUDING its signature member (RFC-ACDP-0017 §10.1).

index.description: Zero-based position of the event in lifecycle_events; MUST equal the receipt's own position in event_receipts.

accepted_at.description: Registry clock at acceptance, canonical millisecond RFC 3339 UTC. Never backdated; non-decreasing in index; >= the context's created_at (RFC-ACDP-0017 §10.1). This, not the actor-claimed occurred_at, is the event's evidence time (RFC-ACDP-0017 §5.1).

signature.description: Registry signature under the receipt key (RFC-ACDP-0010 §5, §9). signature.key_id MUST be a DID URL under registry_did.

$comment: Closed schema, as acdp-registry-receipt.schema.json: every member is signed, so an unknown member would change the preimage.
